translation.title: Rocinha: Private Walk with a Local Guide
translation.format: Private walking tour with a local guide
translation.lead: In the afternoon, you can choose a private tour of Rocinha. Walk through the neighbourhood with a local guide and learn about its history, culture and the everyday lives of its residents.
